note: A 400 whose prose is really an overflow, with no machine-readable code to say so — hence `_looks_like_context_overflow`. ContextTooLong rather than BadRequest because it has a recovery: re-fit the history against the stated limit and retry once against the same provider. It is deliberately NOT failover-eligible; the next candidate's window is usually smaller.

error.message: This endpoint's maximum context length is 262144 tokens. However, you requested about 291204 tokens. Please reduce the length of either the messages or completion.
